race.description: A-Plus Contracting & Poly Welding Midway Mdn Hcp
race.comment: NEVER SAY ASSUME (1) gets the nod on his fresh set-up rather than his debut figure. He was unwanted and well beaten at this track in July, but there was an early block, he has since won a Randwick trial, and barrier 1 gives Dylan Gibbons the right base to produce a sharper first-up run. LLANTARNAM (2) has the strongest exposed placing at this venue, a debut third beaten a length by Cosmic Eagle on soft ground, and third-up fitness offsets the plain Hawkesbury ninth. OAKFIELD KANSAS (9) comes through a country fifth with enough interference and keenness to be assessed leniently, while her previous run at this track was better than the market expected and gives her a genuine platform. HELLFLIGHT (7) is still a maiden with no placing, but she picked up nicely in the straight at Kembla and her Randwick-Kensington effort on heavy ground had merit, making the new 1400m the main test of whether she can turn improving work into a winning threat. The chances don't end there.
